items.source: For example, a DateTimeFormatAnnotationFormatterFactory might create a formatter that formats Date values set on fields annotated with @DateTimeFormat.
items.translation: 例如，DateTimeFormatAnnotationFormatterFactory 可能会创建一个格式化器，用于格式化在带有 @DateTimeFormat 注解的字段上设置的 Date 值。

items.source: The types of fields that may be annotated with the <A> annotation.
items.translation: 可能被<A>注解的字段类型。

items.source: A - the annotation type that should trigger formatting
items.translation: A - 应触发格式化的注解类型

items.source: fieldType - the type of field that was annotated
If the type T the printer accepts is not assignable to fieldType, a coercion from fieldType to T will be attempted before the Printer is invoked.
items.translation: 如果打印机接受的类型 T 不可赋值给 `fieldType`，则在调用 Printer 之前将尝试从 `fieldType` 到 T 的强制转换。

items.source: If the object the parser returns is not assignable to fieldType, a coercion to fieldType will be attempted before the field is set.
items.translation: 如果解析器返回的对象无法赋值给 `fieldType`，在设置字段之前将尝试将其强制转换为 `fieldType`。

items.source: Get the Parser to parse a submitted value for a field of fieldType annotated with annotation.
items.translation: 获取用于解析带有 `annotation` 注解的 `fieldType` 字段的已提交值的 Parser。

items.source: Get the Printer to print the value of a field of fieldType annotated with annotation.
items.translation: 获取打印机以打印带有 `annotation` 注解的 `fieldType` 字段的值。
